MIDIMAN Introduces New MultiMixer 10
for Growing Multimedia Applications

Arcadia, CA MIDIMAN's MultiMixer 10 is an inexpensive, extremely low noise, mic/line mixer specifically designed for multimedia audio applications. In order to provide today's computer audio customer maximum ease of use, this professional quality, 10-channel, stereo mixer features typical computer and A/V connections rather than "pro" ins and outs, and is priced at a very affordable $119.95 msrp.

The MultiMixer 10's six panable inputs (1 through 6) enable a sound source to be placed anywhere in the stereo field. Two of these panable inputs (1 and 2) have 1/4" mono jacks with switchable gain settings for either line level or microphone use. Channels 3 through 6 use RCA mono inputs. MultiMixer 10's four remaining channels (7 through 10), using two 1/8" stereo miniplugs, are unity gain inputs where the signal passes directly to the master stereo gain controls. Since these channels are intended to be controlled "at the source," they are ideal for use as either returns or AV ins for a CD player or sound card. The beige "computer color" compact mixer also features a built-in front 1/8" stereo headphone jack, both dual RCA and 1/8" stereo multimedia main outs, and rugged steel construction.

For more information contact:
MIDIMAN, 45 East Saint Joseph Street, Arcadia, CA 91006.
Tel: (626) 445-2842, Fax: (626) 445-7564
Internet Email: info@midiman.net.
